note: Day/night cycle (D-110). day_seconds = real seconds for one full 24 h day (2880 = 48 min, the same clock the encounters already used: 30 in-game minutes a real minute). The sun climbs to max_elevation_deg at midday and sets at sunset_hour; after that the same light is mirrored to the other side of the sky as the moon, so nights are lit and still cast soft shadows. night_* values are what the look blends TO at full night. wake_hour is the hour sleeping skips to.
bed_day_say: It is daylight. Nobody is sleeping through a day they could be out in.
bed_wake_say: You sleep. The others wake when you do.
